diagnosis_summary: The linked closing commit shows that CssProcessor passed the full CSS @import URL, including its query string, into filesystem path resolution. A preceding stock-theme change introduced query-stamped local Tabler CSS imports, and the public 19.3.1-alpha tag is the parent of the fix. The fix resolves the file with the query removed while preserving the original query when rebuilding the browser URL. Rock labels the issue for the 19.3 release line, but no later public package was available at review time to prove exact build inclusion.
workaround_summaries: Use a Rock build that contains commit aae87fcb73df28c84caa91d3a1e7e390dc6059a7, then verify a representative classic check-in page whose imported CSS URL includes a query string.

verification_playbook.goal: Determine whether classic check-in uses query-stamped local CSS imports on a build that passes the query string into file resolution.
prerequisites: Know the exact installed build or package.

steps.title: Check build ancestry
steps.instructions: Confirm whether the installed build contains commit aae87fcb73df28c84caa91d3a1e7e390dc6059a7.
steps.expected_if_affected: The build is 19.3.1-alpha or another revision after the query-stamped import change but before the fix.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The build contains the fix that removes the query while resolving the local file path.

steps.title: Inspect a static CSS request
steps.instructions: Use browser network tools on a representative classic check-in theme to inspect the imported CSS URL and response without starting a check-in session or submitting attendance.
steps.expected_if_affected: A local CSS import includes a query string and the request fails with the illegal-characters path error.
steps.expected_if_unaffected: The query-stamped CSS request resolves successfully, or the theme does not use the affected import form.
evidence_to_record: query string present yes or no

limitations: A successful theme without a query-stamped local import does not test the affected parser branch.

context.scope: stock classic themes containing query-stamped local Tabler CSS imports
exact source revision; release package inclusion remains unproven
